formal_claims.statement_source:
theorem slow_link_charpoly {m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (C : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin m) ℝ) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 C (0 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ)).charpoly =
      A.charpoly * Polynomial.X

theorem feedback_vector {m : ℕ} (H : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (f z : Fin m → ℝ) (h : ∀ i, ∑ j, H i j*z j=1) (i : Fin m) :
    (∑ j, (-H i j+f j)*z j) = -1+∑ j, f j*z j

theorem coalesced_identity (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (x-1)*(prescribedPair 3 (List.replicate m (3,3))).1.eval (ratio x) -
      2*(prescribedPair 3 (List.replicate m (3,3))).2.eval (ratio x) =
      (x-3)^(2*m+1)

theorem relaxation_balance (a b c s e z ε : ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0)
    (h : a*s*e=(b+c)*z) :
    (a/ε)*s*e=(((b+c)/ε-c)+c)*z

theorem relaxation_positive (b c ε : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) : 0 < (b+c)/ε-c

theorem feedback_ratio_step (a b p q v : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hp : 0 < p) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hv : 0 < v) :
    (10*a+(2+v))*p < (10*b+(2+v))*q

theorem loaded_feedback_elimination (v T U a b : ℝ)
    (htotal : (3*T/2+U)+(7-3*v)*a/2+3*v*b/2=0)
    (hlast : (4-v)*b=T+(1-v)*a) :
    2*(7-4*v)*(2*b-a)=10*T+(2+v)*U

theorem feedback_gap_positive (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (v : ℝ)
    (hv : 0 < v) (hv1 : v < 1) :
    0 < v*(50*(n:ℝ)-45)/(9*(14-8*v))

theorem retune_positive {n : ℕ} (k : Rates n) (l b β : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hk : k.Positive) (hl : ∀ i, 0 < l i) (hb : ∀ i, 0 < b i)
    (hβ : ∀ i, 0 < β i) : (retune k l b β).Positive

theorem retune_equilibrium {n : ℕ} (k : Rates n) (x : State n)
    (l b β : Fin n → ℝ) (hk : k.Positive)
    (hE : ∀ i, k.a i*x.S i.castSucc*x.E=(k.b i+k.c i)*x.C i)
    (hF : ∀ i, k.alpha i*x.S i.succ*x.F=(k.beta i+k.gamma i)*x.D i)
    (hcat : ∀ i, k.c i*x.C i=k.gamma i*x.D i) :
    Equilibrium (retune k l b β) x

theorem large_r_block_certificate (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (v : ℝ)
    (hv : 0 < v) (hv1 : v < 1)
    (H : Matrix (Fin (n-1)) (Fin (n-1)) ℝ) (f z : Fin (n-1) → ℝ)
    (hH : ∀ i, ∑ j, H i j*z j=1)
    (hgain : (∑ j, f j*z j) =
      (10*((4:ℝ)/3-v*((n:ℝ)-(4*(n:ℝ)-3)/9))+(2+v)/3)/(14-8*v)) :
    ∀ i, (∑ j, (-H i j+f j)*z j) < 0

theorem energy_pair (q z t x y : ℝ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    2*q*x*y = q*t/z*x^2+q*z/t*y^2-q*z*t*(x/z-y/t)^2

theorem diagonal_lyapunov_entry (aij aji pi pj di dj : ℝ) :
    (aji*di)*(dj*pj)+(di*pi)*(aij*dj) =
      di*(aji*pj+pi*aij)*dj

theorem diagonal_feedback_action (d f p bz btw : ℝ)
    (hb : bz = -d) (hbt : btw = -d*f) :
    btw+p*bz = -d*(f+p)

theorem diagonal_feedback_strict (d f p z : ℝ)
    (hd : 0<d) (hf : 0<f) (hp : 0<p) (hz : 0<z) :
    -d*(f+p)/z < 0
theorem attainment_succ (m : ℕ) : Attains (m+1) (2*m+1)
theorem sharp_lower_bound (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : Attains n (2*n-1)

theorem prescribedPair_dense (x₀ : ℝ) (ps : List (ℝ × ℝ)) (h₀ : 1 < x₀)
    (hps : ∀ ab ∈ ps, 1 < ab.1 ∧ 1 < ab.2) :
    DensePositive (prescribedPair x₀ ps).1 ps.length ∧
      DensePositive (prescribedPair x₀ ps).2 ps.length

theorem prescribedPair_identity (x₀ x : ℝ) (ps : List (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    (x-1)*(prescribedPair x₀ ps).1.eval (ratio x) -
      2*(prescribedPair x₀ ps).2.eval (ratio x) =
      (x-x₀)*(ps.map (fun ab => (x-ab.1)*(x-ab.2))).prod

theorem enzyme_total_pivot (u s f B D : ℝ) :
    (u*f*B)*(1+s*u*D)-(u*(1+s*B))*(f*u*D)=u*f*(B-u*D)

theorem residual_factorization (x v ell : ℝ) (hx : 1 < x) :
    v*(ell+v)-2*ratio x*ell^2 =
      -2*ratio x*(ell-2*v/(x-1))*(ell+2*v/(x+1))

theorem distinct_root_product_ne_zero {k : ℕ} (xs : Fin k → ℝ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective xs) (j : Fin k) :
    (∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (xs j-xs i)) ≠ 0

theorem slope_factor_negative (x r nr jr draw : ℝ) (hx : 1 < x)
    (hr : ratio x < r) (hn : 0 < nr) (hj : 0 < jr) (hd : 0 < draw) :
    -16*(1+ratio x)*(jr*x+4*r*nr-jr)/
      ((r-ratio x)*(x+1)^2*draw) < 0

manuscript_formal_scope: The current 34-page manuscript establishes equilibrium capacity 2n-1 and stable-state capacity n by a combination of conventional mathematics and compiled algebra. Lean proves the literal positive mass-action equilibrium lower-bound construction and selected coalescence, source-preserving retuning, feedback-gap and diagonal identities. The full stable-state capacity theorem is not a Lean endpoint. Its ceiling, interlacing and positivity arguments, determinant/slope formulas, loaded matrix derivations and limiting identities, M-matrix/Gershgorin arguments, and spectral perturbation are conventional. Conditional algebra does not establish its analytic premises. The exact finite witnesses and operational/recovery computations are not kernel-checked. Strict original console receipts bind the complete unchanged module closure and pinned environment; the equilibrium lower-bound root has a saved elaborated standard-axiom interface, while the diagonal-algebra receipt has no declaration probes.
